candidates.name: ROLLING_CROSS_SECTIONAL_BUYER_FLOW_ACCELERATION

rules: use exactly four completed one-minute bars ending at trigger time
rank the score against completed scores in the trailing seven days, including equal-time queue peers but no later timestamp
accept score percentile >= 0.60 as the only new gate
enter at the existing trigger next open with unchanged structural stop and account protections
